title: Pseudodifferential structure, rigidity, and sharpness for the Steklov problem on differential forms
summary: We resolve four questions concerning Karpukhin's Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator on differential forms. First, for $0\leq p\leq n-2$, we prove that the operator is classical pseudodifferential of order one and compute its principal symbol, which is elliptic on the coclosed symbol space. This answers Open Question 7.19 in the survey of Colbois, Girouard, Gordon, and Sher [7]. Second, the symbol calculation yields a Weyl law with remainder $O(τ^{n-2})$, resolving the smooth case of their Open Question 7.23 in [7].
